Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer lists "Henry O. Fairbanks and Thomas P. Koch" as the mayors during the opening and closing of Quincy Medical Center, respectively. The Predicted Answer explicitly states that the medical center opened in 1890 when Henry O. Fairbanks was mayor and closed on December 26, 2014, during the tenure of Thomas P. Koch. Therefore, the important information in the Ground Truth Answer is fully present in, and even expanded upon by, the Predicted Answer.
